units.source_text: 夫人的父亲式部卿亲王闻此消息，说道：

en.t: The lady's father, Prince Shikibukyo, heard this news and said:

units.source_text: “照此说来，他已经把我女儿当作弃妇看待了。

en.t: "If that is so, he has already treated my daughter as an abandoned wife.

units.source_text: 如今若再忍气吞声，我们太没有面子，岂不被天下人取笑？

en.t: If we endure this in silence any longer, we will lose all face; would we not be laughed at by everyone?

units.source_text: 只要我活在世间，我女儿何必专心一意地追随他呢？”

en.t: As long as I am alive in this world, why should my daughter devote herself entirely to following him?"

units.source_text: 便立刻派人去迎接女儿回家。

en.t: He immediately sent people to bring his daughter home.

units.source_text: 此时夫人情绪已恢复正常，正在愁叹身世之不幸，忽闻父亲派人来接，想道：

en.t: By then the lady had recovered her composure and was lamenting the misfortune of her life when she suddenly heard that her father had sent people to fetch her, and she thought:

units.source_text: “我倘强欲留在这里，等待丈夫正式和我决绝，然后死心塌地回娘家去，那就更加惹人取笑了。”

en.t: "If I stubbornly remain here, wait for my husband to break with me formally, and only then resign myself to returning to my family home, that will make people laugh at me all the more."
So she decided to go back.

units.source_text: 来接的是夫人的三个哥哥：中将、侍从及民部大辅。

en.t: Those who came to fetch her were the lady's three elder brothers: the Middle Captain, the Chamberlain, and the Senior Assistant Minister of Popular Affairs.

units.source_text: 另一哥哥兵卫督官位较高，行动招摇，所以未来。

en.t: Another brother, the Captain of the Palace Guards, held a higher rank and would draw too much attention if he moved about, so he did not come.
Only three carriages had been sent.

units.source_text: 夫人的侍女们早就料到有这一天。

en.t: The lady's attendants had long expected that this day would come.

units.source_text: 现在看见果然如此，想起今天是住在此邸内的最后一天了，大家簌簌地流下泪来。

en.t: Now that they saw it had truly come to pass, and realized that this was their last day living in this residence, they all began to shed tears silently.
The lady quietly said to them:

units.source_text: “我长久不回家了，此次回去，犹似旅居，哪里用得着许多人呢？

en.t: "I have not gone home for a long time; returning now will feel almost like staying as a traveler, so why would I need so many people?

units.source_text: 你们之中有几个人暂且回娘家去，等我在那边住定之后再说。”

en.t: Some of you should go back to your own family homes for the time being, and we can decide what to do after I have settled there."

units.source_text: 众侍女便各自收拾零星物件，搬回娘家，邸内弄得散乱无章。

en.t: The attendants each packed up their miscellaneous belongings and carried them back to their family homes, leaving the residence in complete disorder.

units.source_text: 夫人的用品，凡需要的，也都包装起来，以便运回。

en.t: The lady's own necessities were also all wrapped up so they could be transported back.

units.source_text: 此时上下人等，无不哭泣，真乃凄凉之极！

en.t: At that moment, everyone high and low was weeping; it was truly the height of desolation.
